rationale: No Mendelian diseases are caused by loss-of-function (LoF) variants. GWAS signals for bone density and corneal traits are strong but do not indicate severe systemic safety risks.

rationale: High LOEUF (0.7) and low pLI (0.13) indicate strong LoF tolerance. No DepMap dependency and secreted/membrane status suggest safe druggability. Missense constraint is also absent.
